gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all project categories to better organize my projects and ensure they are categorized correctly.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all project categories, including their IDs and names, in a structured format.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to create a new project category so that I can group related projects together for better management.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the category name and return the created category's details, including its ID.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to delete a project category that is no longer needed to keep the project categories list clean and relevant.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the project category and return a success message.

gold.user: As a team member, I want to retrieve details of a specific project category to understand its purpose and associated projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified project category, including its name and any associated projects.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to update the name of an existing project category to reflect changes in our project organization strategy.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the new category name and return the updated category's details.
